property_summary: For any actor and any new sum value, once the contract is initialized, calling SetMinSum must leave MinSum unchanged (the reference reverts and preserves it, whereas the buggy version silently returns without reverting but also without updating, so the deciding difference is that the reference reverts while the bug does not — the observable rule is: if initialized, SetMinSum must revert and MinSum must stay equal to its prior value).
change_summary: Replace the body of the guard with `return;`, so the call completes without reverting and without updating MinSum when already initialized.
